newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan buys 50,000 tonnes of Indian sugar.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan buys 50,000 tonnes of Indian sugar.

text.p: The state-run Trading Corp of Pakistan (TCP) said on Tuesday it had purchased 50,000 tonnes of Indian sugar at $350 and $360 per tonne for delivery by January 11.
The State Trading Corporation of India would deliver 25,000 tonnes of sugar at $350 per tonne FOR (freight on rail) via Wagah border near Lahore by January 11, a TCP official said.
The Indian Sugar and General Industry Corp would deliver 25,000 tonnes at $360 per tonne CFFO (cost, freight, free out) by sea at Karachi port by January 11, the official said.
Bids were opened on Saturday, a sugar dealer said.
